decision_scope: Frozen condition (a) alone is dispositive for this conjunctive claim. A null secondary condition remains unmeasured and is not treated as a pass or failure. This logical failure of the support rule does not show an opposite treatment effect.

estimate.method: Callaway-Sant'Anna-style outcome-regression group-time ATT(g,t), conditional on terms-of-trade change and latest observed pretreatment WGI; not-yet/never-treated controls
estimate.uncertainty: delete-one-contributing-country jackknife, t reference; few-cohort limitation
estimate.wgi_baseline_rule: latest observed WGI at or before g-1; no post-adoption backfill

evidence_tier_reason: The primary condition fails the conjunction, but the early 1999 cohorts lack a pure five-year pre-adoption volatility window; few treated cohorts and jackknife uncertainty limit causal generalization.
falsification_rule_text: Not supported if (a) DiD ATT on cpi_inflation_yoy is not negative at p < 0.10, OR (b) within-country inflation volatility (5-yr rolling SD) does not decline post-adoption, OR (c) cumulative log_gdp_pc growth post-adoption is materially below the non-adopter comparison (a more-than-trivial growth penalty).
verdict: REFUTED — preregistered support conjunction failed because primary negative-ATT significance condition (a) failed; no opposite effect is established
